shard_optimizer_with_fairscale: shard a PyTorch optimizer using FairScale OSS for distributed training across GPU groups
create_metaseqoss_subclass: create a MetaseqOSS subclass that overrides broadcast_global_state_dict to broadcast state dicts from rank 0
disable_mem_eff_fp16_hack: disable the memory efficient fp16 loading hack by setting disable_mem_eff_fp16_loading_hack property to True
proxy_supports_attributes: proxy supports* attribute lookups from MetaseqOSS to the underlying optimizer via __getattr__
broadcast_state_dict_across_ranks: broadcast the full optimizer state dictionary from rank 0 to all ranks in the process group
